nom: Good Molecules Hydrating Gel Moisturizer with Electrolytes

avis.titre: Good moisturizer, but pills under everything
avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for about a month now, and I really wanted to love it, but it keeps pilling under my sunscreen. It's a decent moisturizer, super light weight, and doesn't break me out (i have really acne prone skin). I only use it at night though because it pill too much under sunscreen to use during the day.

Disappointed… claims to be ideal for oily skin, but like other reviews say, it's extremely drying once it settles after applying. It doesn't "melt" into your skin, even though thats the entire point of a moisturizer??? It creates a layer product buildup that becomes dry and flaky. Sure, dry is the opposite of oily, but this is extreme. Not sure what skin type would benefit from using this product. This brand continues to miss the mark. Not impressed at all, unfortunately. Back to "The Ordinary" products (for the same price or less!)

I have acne and dry skin, i domt prefer a thick moisturizer because i live in south fl and its summer. This leaves my smin feeling tight, dry, and itchy. Ive used it for about a month now (i dont know why! ) and its only gotten worse. Its also terrible under makeup
I like that its a gel moisturizer and I tried to give it a chance but anytime i apply makeup over it flakes EVERYWHEREEE. I hate it

I bought this to try a new lighter feeling moisturizer during the warmer parts of the year. The gel is clear and absorbs nicely into my combination skin. I think since summer only recently started and it is still relatively cool here, my skin felt a little dry after use. I will keep using this product throughout this season as it will likely be more effective in the hotter and humid months.
Omg first time trying it literally burns and it's too sticky wouldn't recommend
This goes on so smoothly with no greasy feeling. My skin looks and feels so much better.
Not the best product if you are looking for hydration, maybe a good eye cream substitute since it left my skin feeling tight

This product is unscented which is great for my sensitive skin. It absorbs quickly too. It also works well on top of my niacinamide and vitamin C serums. I wear a mineral sunscreen on top and it doesn't pill.

avis.titre: Everything i'm looking for in a moisturizer!
avis.texte: I had the daily lightweight moisturizer from Good Molecules before this, and my skin just needed something else with a boost of moisture. This gel formula is perfect for my skin I love it!

This moisturizer is a total game changer for me! The creme moisturizers are too much for my face and cause me to break out. I love the fact that this one is a gel moisturizer and it has helped my face a lot with glow and softness etc.

I love this moisturizer. It's like a gel and it absorbs fast. It's a great morning moisturizer before you put on your make up. I've been told my skin is so soft. I have combination skin but I usually need something a little more hydrating so this moisturizer has helped a lot!

Gives that cooling gel effect, but it did not feel moisturizing. Just felt like a film over my face. Made my skin feel tight after applying. Pilled a lot even without wearing makeup on top. Theres better moisturizers out there, don't waste your time on this one.

If you have oily acne prone skin YOU NEED THIS. It doesnt leave any residue behind actually soaks into my skin and didnt make me more oily, actually controlled my oil. Doesnt clog my pores like other moisturizers did. 10/10
Not hyrating. Actually felt like it dried me out and pills under make il.
This is a nice lightweight moisturizer especially if you have oily skin. My fav morning moisturizer and it feels so refreshing on the skin.

avis.titre: I love the texture, and so does my skin, but it pills like c
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this stuff. It goes on well, and my skin definitely doesn't hate it, but it pills under anything! Any primer I've used makes it pill, and even wearing it under the GM sunscreen makes it pill. It even pills a little on its own? I'm hoping it's just me, because it is moisturizing despite being so light, and I really think it would be great if it didn't pill so much! I hate that I bought the duo earlier this year, because I've barely used the first one. I guess I'll give it away to someone that it doesn't pill for. I love GM products, but apparently this one doesn't love me back!

This product's great for me. I have a dry skin type, and this works any time of day or night when I need a little extra hydration to my skin. I dont recommend for oily skin types, and don't suggest using it as an only hydration method in your skin routine. I usually always apply last thing before going to bed and keeps my face from drying out overnight. Definitely a buy!
This is the first moisturizer I've used in a long time that has consistently worked with my combination/oily skin. It is so light weight and absorbs instantly to my skin!

Good moisturizer! Balances well with my combination skin by using this in the morning and a creamier moisturizer at night. It is lightweight and leaves my skin feeling hydrated—my only issue is that it's sticky, it kinda glues my eyebrows down and I have to wash my hands after using. Overall 4/5!! Love it 🫶
i've only been using it for a couple weeks by my skin feel so hydrated, and paired with the cleansing bar my skin is finally clearing up.

avis.titre: Hydrating Gel Moisturizer with Electrolytes Review
avis.texte: I like how it leaves my face with a soft, glow. My reactions really well this product during the summer and winter. It is not too much when layered with other skin care products.

I recently tried out this product & really liked it! It's not heavy on your skin & leaves it feeling moisturized & hydrated without using much product! The only slight downside is that it's a little sticky afterwards. However, it's very minimal. Overall, a very nice product.

I recently tried out this product & really liked it! It's not heavy on your skin & leaves it feeling moisturized & hydrated without using much product! The only slight downside is that it's a little sticky afterwards. However, it's very minimal. Overall, a very nice product!
Having an oil skin type, I struggle with having my skin moisturized and not overall producing sebum.
This moisturizer has the best texture, I put it on before bed and my skin feels amazing and hydrated the next day
This is the first moisturizer that hasn't made my face oily after.
Absolutely love this product leaves my skin feeling healthy and hydrated for the day

I am a huge good molecules fan, but this product missed the mark, for me. Feels great going on, but when it dries it feels tight, almost like an egg white mask. I got a little in my hairline and when it dried it was translucent and webby in my hair. Unfortunately, I can't speak to how well the product actually works because using the product was unpleasant.

avis.titre: It does very well with th
avis.texte: It does very well with the other products and it doesn't feel heavy

avis.titre: Turns to flake and fluff after putting on
avis.texte: I'm a person of color and after putting this on. Under a few minutes it dries up and turns to fluff/flakes on my face and it has this webby feeling. At first I thought it was pilling from using serums so I used it alone at night and woke up the next morning with even more flake/fluff on my face. I bought 2 so I'm very sad at this because it did make my skin feel smooth but I will not be purchasing again

The best moisturizer i have ever used! It moisturizes my skin jus enough without making me feel like i have so much on! My combination (mainly oily) always makes it difficult for me to care for moisturizing skin but this product eliminates this problem by a lot.

This mousterizer doesn't break out my skin or otherwise give me a bad reaction, but it's more like a serum. I have to use about a teaspoon every morning and night (yikes) for it to remotely hydrate my skin. Even then it doesn't feel like enough.

avis.titre: Great for summer, under makeup wear
avis.texte: I needed something hydrating between a lotion and serum for summer. This stuff almost has a snail mucin consistency and it absorbs into the skill well. I've been using this under my makeup for a week now and I swear it's also evened my skin tone! I don't even need to put lotion on in the morning because this is so hydrating and I can wear makeup over it and there's no creasing or dryness. I will be purchasing for future summers!!!

This product is great for summer. It is light and non greasy. I use it on casual no makeup days or at night if I need a moisture boost on a hot bight. It's a tiny bit sticky so I would be a bit afraid that it would flake or be uncomfortable on a fancy makeup day. It serves a purpose for me and I fundamentally like it. I am a huge Good Molecules fan for the simplicity, low scent, great prices, and effectiveness of their products!

I have spent countless dollars on expensive face moisturizers but Good Molecules Hydrating Moisturizer with Electric is not only affordable but beats all the rest. I'm so happy I discovered this brand thanks to Nina Pool.

I have spent countless dollars on expensive face moisturizers but Good Molecules Hydrating Moisturizer with Electric is not only affordable but beats all the rest. I'm so happy I discovered this brand thanks to Nina Pool.

avis.titre: Yes but more so a serum
avis.texte: I really like the product. I have combo skin, i use this after i wash my face in the morning before spf, I've found that my skin doesn't get as oily. I probably only use it hotter months, it wont be enough hydration for winter.

Feels similar to an aloe vera gel. Not sticky but I don't find this moisturizer super moisturizing, so I don't use it everyday. I only use it if I'm going to go outside and it's hot out and don't want to feel oily. But I also find that if I combine this with the SPF from Good Molecules it tends to pill. I personally wouldn't buy it again but my mom who hates the feeling of moisturizer really likes it.

I was very excited when this first launched as i have a combo skin type. The oil-free, water based formula seemed like a good fit for me at first. Unfortunately, this product does not work well with others, even with GM products. I was really disappointed by the performance as it does feel hydrating when applied. I have dealt with breakouts and pilling since purchasing. I hope GM reformulates this product, as I believe it can be improved.
Feels loght on the skin. I thought it was gonna feel sticky on the skin because of its gel texture but its not and quite hydrating.
This gel was the best on my skin, it left it soft, moisturized and without irritation.
It's honestly does nothing, it feels like water going on the face and drying. My skin honestly felt more dry after using this. Would only recommend if you are very oily prone
Again, it feels nice! Its just very thin and it pills when you put another product on top of it like sunscreen.

I'm always nervous to try a new moisturizer, I break out so easily with new products, but I've had such great results with Good Molecules that I ordered it. I'm very happy with the results so far. No breakouts, I don't look greasy 3 hours after application like I do with most moisturizers, and my recent hormonal breakout scars are fading faster than usual. I use it after the niacinamide toner and serum and it's actually making my skin look noticeably better. I will definitely reorder.

I'm always nervous to try a new moisturizer, I break out so easily with new products, but I've had such great results with Good Molecules that I ordered it. I'm very happy with the results so far. No breakouts, I don't look greasy 3 hours after application like I do with most moisturizers, and my recent hormonal breakout scars are fading faster than usual. I use it after the niacinamide toner and serum and it's actually making my skin look noticeably better. Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Best For Oily Acne Prone Skin
avis.texte: This moisturizer is the only one I have found that doesn't cause breakouts or irritate my sensitive skin. I tend to be oily but using a face wash without a moisturizer makes my skin angry. I have tried so many affordable moisturizers Cetaphil, crave, la.roche,, byoma, and countless others. This is it. It also initially is a little tacky so I wonder how it will fair under makeup. I've been using it for about a month now but haven't had energy to do a full makeup look but it sits well under sunscreen and concealer. For the winter time I'll likely go back to the Ordinary moisturizer because that, too, works well buts it's way too heavy for the summer months. (Also the ordinary lightweight gel irritates my skin, it's only the medium level moisturizer). All in all if you are oily and acne prone and don't want a moisturizer that sits on your skin give this a shot.
This is pretty soild moisturizer. It leaves my skin feeling nice and hydrated and doesn't feel greasy. As someone with ance prone skin it also didn't break me out at all.
It glides on nice but then was very drying after a few minutes. It was also a bit sticky

This moisturizer is THIN and did absolutely nothing for my skin. My skin is combo with an oily Tzone for reference. I knew after the first use this would be a dud product but I used it for a solid week to fully test it out. I had to go over my skin within an hour with another gel moisturizer because it did nothing for my skin. Don't waste your time!

I have combination skin and have been breaking out heavily in my T-zone so I've been looking for something gentle to balance my dry patches on my cheeks with my oily areas. I could see this being good for someone with oily skin all over, but unfortunately it just hasn't been enough for my dry patches. I've also tried the lotion form of their daily mosturizer and that one felt too thick so... onto the next lol.

So far I'm loving it, however I'm giving it four stars as I've used it twice and on the second use I had some peeling. I will say I recently had a sunburn from PRIDE and or it could also be because I feel I used more this time. I will be updating my stars and review after a couple more tries.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: Did not feel moisturizing at all. The consistency is very thin, almost like an oil. Would not repurchase.
This is WONDERFUL for oily/combination skin 12/10 would recommend!
Love the lightweight feel of it. My skin feels moisturized and glows without heavy oils.

I really enjoyed this moisturizer! Thinner texture but very hydrating and dries nicely. Not greasy feeling at all. The downside is that it pilled later in the day. I also use the Good Molecules Hyaluronic Acid serum, niacinamide serum, and daily brightening serum.
Just bought this 3 days ago and I love it already! It pairs well underneath my makeup, gives my face hydration without being oily, so worth the try!
I have oily skin and it's my ideal moisturizer for my skin type. It absorbs super fast and is also compatible with makeup, which makes me love it even more.
Love the way my skin feels after going through my routines. I also love that it's not shiny. Work in progress!!
For being someone with oily skin, it still doesn't hydrate my skin enough and i feel i need a lot to see some sort of moisture, its not terrible to use but its not my favorite

Its a really good moisturizer i use teice a day. The only think i dont like is that its a bit sticky once it dries but i hsually put suncreen or oil on top depending on the time of day to reduce the stickiness

Okay, this hydrating gel moisturizer is Chefs' kiss! I have oily skin so I need the hydration and it's working. My skin feels more hydrated and not oily and greasy. If you haven't tried it yet, don't hesitate!
This hydrating gel, simply works I'm 51 and my eye puffiness and forehead look and feel nurtured after applying it.

I have pretty oily skin on general but especially in the summer (I live in humid VA) so it works for me! I don't see a way anyone else could use this lol even if you have combo skin this still might be too lightweight for you in the summer. Calling it a gel is a stretch I think it's more like a serum which is honestly great for my skin in the summer. I gave it 4 starts cuz I feel like this won't be good when I use something really drying on my face like benzoyl peroxide and it probably won't work for me during most other seasons
Oh! I love it.. and keeps it locked throughout my 2hr workout and no need to apply anything else

avis.titre: Review Hydrating Gel Moisturizer with Electrolytes
avis.texte: I think it's an excellent product for people with combination or very oily skin. The product is super lightweight, and just two drops are more than enough to apply to the entire face. 10/10 for this product, I highly recommend it!

I absolutely love this moisturizer. It is perfect for my oily skin, especially in summer when I don't want to feel too heavy or product on my face. It feels so good when I apply it and moisturizes very well!

This was a bit thinner than I'm used to, but it layers well with the hyaluronic acid booster and serum. I tend to look oily later in the day, using a different brand, but this one is perfect! It gives a dewy look under makeup, just make sure to let it absorb fully before applying makeup.
i really wanted to lile this but it foams up on my fave ive tried many different techniques and still suds up like soap and dosnt deliver hydration honestly
wasn't hydrating, didn't JUST break me out but killed my skin barrier & triggered my roseaca to flare up. I'm on day 7 of healing my face. (I have oily, acne prone, roseaca sensitive skin)

avis.titre: It was good til it wasn't
avis.texte: I bought this to try it out because I have oily skin. The first couple of days it was doing pretty well then one time i noticed extreme redness in my chin and around the lip area. Also more pimples were forming as well. You can try it out for yourself but i personally wouldn't recommend

I've been using this for a few weeks and it has definitely made a difference in my routine. My esthetician recommended a non-oil moisturizer and I already knew to check if Good molecules had one before looking at any other brand. I trust their ingredients!
I enjoy this moisturizer. It hydrates my face without feeling heavy or sticky. I would recommend this moisturizer for ppl with combination skin like mine, or oily skin.
Great this is perfect for summer or a light moisturizer under your makeup

I found it went on kind of silky and smooth. Not oily at all and sinks right into your skin. Easy to apply makeup overtop. More of a liquid than a cream. I use it mostly during the day because it goes well under makeup.

I really wanted to like this product. Upon application it feels very hydrating but after a couple of minutes my skin feels tight. I also noticed pilling when I put on my makeup and that never happens. After a couple of days I also notice some pimples starting to form.

avis.titre: I like how it makes my fa
avis.texte: I like how it makes my face feel hydrated but it makes it sticky sadly but iverall its very good
I love it for my Oily skin 🙌 💜 goodmolecules the best skincare products 💯💯
Before I wrote a review I wore it all day to see results. I am less oily than I would be with my other moisturizer and I loved the texture and consistency.
I dont like this product. It doesnt absorb into the face all the way causing it to peel in weird ways.
I'm loving the new gel moisturizer, definitely will be buying more

I have oily combo skin and this has been working great for my skin. It's my first time using a gel consistency type of moisturizer so that was new to me. BUT I love the way it feels on my skin. Super lightweight, hydrating, not sticky, and under my makeup it looked so nice. Not drying at all super hydrating without leaving my face oily. Love it!!
Amazing left my skin moisturizer without feeling to heavy on my skin!
This moisterizer is nice! I have dry skin, so while this wasn't hydrating enough for me, I like to use it when my skin is breaking out or my pores are more clogged than normal.
Love the moisturizer. My face doesn't feel oily after using it. Looking fresh all day.
This feels so good on my skin very hydrating. I need to order more my go to moisturizing when I need hydration.
One of my fav skincare brands in general, but love this moisturizer! Great for my oily prone skin without drying me out!

avis.titre: Not a bad product, but not for me.
avis.texte: It wasn't bad, but it wasnt enough hydration for my skin. It was nice for layering with another moisturizer or sunscreen (and it didn't pill) but alone, my skin felt smooth but still tight and dry. My skin has a couple pretty rough dry spots though since I use a very potent prescription retinol for acne. I ended up returning it but you might enjoy it if you have oily skin.

My skin doesn't love to absorb lotions when it is too warm, so I got this to try. I love it, my skin drinks it in and looks/feels so hydrated and plump. I can't wait to add it to my daily routine this summer. Another great product from Good Molecules!

I was so excited to use this product. At first it left a nice glow, after a few days I developed dehydrated tight skin, and I broke out badly just days before that. Im using zit patches. I RARELY need them. I was hoping it was just a purge but my skin looks so dull now and irritated and red. 😔 My skin type is combination, acne prone and sensitive.
Such a great gel moisturizer that leaves your face smooth and soft! Definitely recommend.
I love all their products I've tried so far. I loved the Hydrating Gel because it does its job and leaves a nice sheen look.

This item worked well! I have very acne prone skin and oily skin and this didn't make those worse. It really helped with the oil. I do however wish it was a little more hydrating. I noticed some dry patches of skin that I didn't typically have, especially around active and recovering acne. Overall I would recommend this product!

avis.titre: Better Than I Thought It Would Be
avis.texte: I love using this after serums at night and before sunscreen during the day. It's a gel, but you can feel it really sink in like a moisturizer. My skin always feels nice, especially at bedtime.

Very few products can control my oily skin. Usually after 1 hour I have to use a napkin to wipe oil off my face. This gel moisturizer really controls the oil my skin produces. My skin is not shiny anyone. Great product

I have oily/combination skin and I love this product, it feels amazing on skin but when I added my spf on top it started to pill badly and I wear spf everyday. I was kinda disappointed but I hope you guys can't fix the issue soon cause I love it !!!
I love it bur it statts pealing and flaking under my sunscreen and makeup:((

avis.titre: Maybe better for in the summer vs. colder weather
avis.texte: I like this gel moisturizer so far! Normally I feel like gel moisturizers leave my skin feeling sticky, but this one soaks in super fast with so sticky feeling. My skin might be a little too dry for this, I end up putting some neutral lotion over. But overall, not bad for the price!

its hydrating but you absolutely need to put on moisturizer. you also cant wear it by itself, it needs something light over it to keep in moisture. it could work really well as a primer. its very cheap for the quality, its very good.

This is a really nice facial moisturizer. It's really watery and I think it's best applied to the face with the tip of the tube. Sinks in good and doesn't leave the skin greasy. I will say though that it does make my sunscreen pill when I apply on top of the moisturizer after it has dried. So that's a no for me unfortunately.
